
# _Tipping Study - Visualize 3d movement_

---
### Setup

###### Workspace

```{R}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
```

###### Data

```{R}
load(here::here("data", "proc", "02_out.rdata"))
```

---

```{R}
dt[
  participant_id == 51 & trial_num == 4 & block_num == 2
] |> plot_ly(
  data = _,
  x = ~hand_z,
  y = ~hand_x,
  z = ~hand_y,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "lines",
  opacity = 1,
  line = list(
    width = 6,
    reverscale = FALSE
  )
)
```
